Name: Rimmon in Zebulun
ModernLocation: Unknown; possibly Rumana, in Zebulun's allotment
Description: A town of Zebulun named in the allotment list, on the border running toward the valley; distinct from the Rimmon of Benjamin and the Rimmon of Simeon.
BiblicalSignificance: Rimmon in Zebulun is a border town of Zebulun's inheritance.
